about: Other models, measured: checkable tasks run on several models through tools/llm.mjs (OpenRouter), scored automatically against answers copied from this site's own data room. A row is a model at one reasoning setting. right / asked count RUNS: each item is asked up to three times of a row (repeats in models/evals/models.json), so asked = items x runs. run_right lists the items right in run 1, 2, 3: their spread is the only error bar here. Small samples: read the counts.

warnings-in-force.scoring: the set of warnings (type, level, end) equals the gold set exactly: none missing, none extra

extract-decision.title: Extract a decision
extract-decision.scoring: each field exact; an item is right when all three are. The model's one-line 'what' is published and not scored.

translate.title: Translate, figures kept
translate.scoring: the numbers in the answer are the numbers in the source (each as many times, in any order); every unit present; and the answer is not the Portuguese text again
